body.system: You are a test assistant. Use the tools when the user asks for them.

messages.content: Think carefully before acting. A city is chosen as follows: list the ten largest European capitals by population, reason step by step about which of them has the most rainy days per year, double-check your reasoning, and then call get_weather exactly once for the city you chose. Do not answer before calling the tool.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city.

tools.name: get_time
tools.description: Get the current UTC time. Takes no arguments.
